basis: Supplementary hand calculations for zero balances, eight-decimal products and same-day FIFO. Original EXPECTED.json remains unchanged.

depletion.calculation: 1000 buys 10 at 100 with zero fee. Closing price 0: cost 1000, cash 0, value 0, unrealized and net P&L -1000. No return metric is claimed.

funded.calculation: Start with zero cash, deposit 1000, then gain case. Closing NAV 1047 minus opening 0 minus contributions 1000 = profit 47.

same_day_fifo.calculation: Start with 1000; buy 1 at 100, buy 1 at 150, buy 1 at 100 all same day; sell 2 at 120. FIFO consumes cost 250, realizes -10, cash 890. Remaining cost 100, mark 130, unrealized 30, net 20, NAV 1020.
